panels.title: A1 Milling Machine - Failure Probability (ML Predictor)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "A1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "jesa/site1/workshop/milling/A1/analytics/machine_failure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "probability")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
